nodes.summary: For every real $C > 0$ there is an $N$ such that for every $n \ge N$ and every graph $G$ on the natural numbers there is a finite set $X \subseteq \{2, \dots, n\}$ that is a clique or an independent set of $G$ and satisfies $\sum_{x \in X} 1 / \log x \ge C$.
nodes.title: Monochromatic sets of large logarithmic weight exist

nodes.summary: The statement that for every real $C > 0$ there is an $N$ such that for every $n \ge N$ and every graph $G$ on the natural numbers (its edges and non-edges 2-colour the pairs of $\{2, \dots, n\}$) there is a finite set $X \subseteq \{2, \dots, n\}$ that is a clique or an independent set of $G$ (a monochromatic set) with $\sum_{x \in X} 1 / \log x \ge C$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 191
